verdict.rationale: Docs describe ingestion mechanics (raw content ingestion, customId dedup, connectors with webhooks, automatic extraction) but there is no mention of a batch/async ingestion API, job IDs, or an endpoint/mechanism to check the status of background memory-processing operations — the evidence pack contains no support for this platform-engineer-facing capability. missing for 10: batch ingestion API, async job/task status endpoint, documentation of processing queue or webhook completion callbacks.
